name: Yuuki Kaho
source:
At first glance, she appears to be a kind and gentle teacher. In reality, she is cruel and treats the underachieving students who don't do as she wants like garbage.

She has no experience with men. She is also the principal's daughter and a naive young lady.

[Translated from [url=https://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HB/onnakyoushi/index.html]Official Site[/url]]
